undeclaredWalk.text: This path takes a directory walk outside its package, and nothing declares what the walk reads, so a change to those files won't rerun this package's tests: they stay green on a stale result and the red surfaces later on someone else's change. Declare it with a `// Reads: <glob>` comment on this line or just above it, one glob per comment, and a matching reads line in {{readsFile}}.
